title: A concert in the park
instructions: Lisa parkta gittiği konseri anlatıyor. Kiminle gittiğine ve ne olduğuna dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last Saturday, there was a free concert in the city park.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I went with my best friend, Jo.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We took a blanket and some sandwiches and sat on the grass.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The music was great, but at nine o'clock it suddenly started to rain.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Everyone ran to the trees, but the band kept playing!
